name: City of Asheville
qualityWhy: Official press releases with full text, featured image on every post, and two taxonomies (category + avl_department) that make filtering easy. Includes police chief appointments, council recaps, Helene recovery, budget and housing decisions.
recommendationWhy: The primary source for city government; APD, AFD and Water Resources publish here (avl_department taxonomy) rather than separately.
testResult: OK - 30 articles 2026-07-29..2026-09-24; summary/contentText/image/categories 100%, avg body 2969 chars
notes: ~40% noise: Parks & Rec event roundups (category 'Events', dept 'Parks and Recreation'), holiday closures, Emergency Preparedness Month PSAs. 'News' and 'Featured' terms are on nearly every post and are dropped. The embedded WP author is hidden (RSS dc:creator shows a comms staffer), so author is left empty. 'Actions and presentations at the <date> City Council Meeting' posts are thin (link + YouTube); the substance is in the action agenda that AVL_COUNCIL_AGENDA reads. The same site's `meetings` post type is used by the agenda source.

name: Asheville City Council Agendas
qualityWhy: Forward-looking and structured: the City Clerk's public 'Draft Council 8-Week Planning Calendar' Google Doc lists consent items, public hearings and new business per meeting up to 8 weeks out (e.g. 'Public Hearing - Economic Development Incentive Grant to Support Project Vessel' for Oct 13). After each meeting the attached 'Action Agenda' doc records every resolution and its vote.
recommendationWhy: This is the 'council votes Tuesday on X' signal, weeks before newsrooms write it, plus a factual record of what passed.
testResult: OK - 4 articles (Sep 22 action agenda; Oct 13, Oct 27, Nov 10 draft agendas); summary/contentText/categories 100%
notes: One article per meeting. sourceId is stable per meeting and phase (council-2026-10-13-agenda, council-2026-09-22-actions) so re-scrapes update in place; a formal agenda doc, when attached to an upcoming meeting, replaces the draft under the same sourceId. publishedAt is when the current version was posted (agenda page dateModified for drafts, meeting start for action agendas), never the future meeting date. The draft doc is found each run by its '8-week' link text on the agenda page, so a new doc id is picked up automatically. Only meetings with a matching WP meeting record are emitted (that record supplies the URL). Agenda briefings, closed sessions and cancelled meetings are skipped. The meetings post type also covers ~40 boards (Planning & Zoning, HRC, recovery boards) whose agendas are Google Drive folders, not docs, so they are not read. Shape fits for v1 but see the agendas note in the final report: agendas probably deserve their own table.

name: Buncombe County

access.robots: RSSFeed.aspx and /m/newsflash allowed (only /RSS.aspx listing page is disallowed)

qualityWhy: County government's own releases: commissioner decisions and recaps, elections (the Board of Elections has no separate feed), public health (measles exposure, cyclosporiasis), EMS, Helene recovery, housing awards, grants.
recommendationWhy: The only structured channel for Buncombe County government and elections news; high volume and a lot of it is later rewritten by newsrooms.
testResult: OK - 27 articles 2026-08-28..2026-09-24; summary 85%, image 100%; fetchFullText ok on 3/3 (928-3356 chars)
notes: localOnly. Cloudflare WAF returns 'Attention Required!' 403 to Node fetch and to fetchAsChrome, and also to six undici TLS/ALPN variants tried (h1/h2, TLS1.2/1.3, Schannel-like ciphers) and to non-browser UAs. Windows curl (Schannel) with ONLY a browser User-Agent gets 200; the same curl plus browser Accept/Accept-Language headers gets 403. The module shells out to curl (execFile, fixed args) and falls back to fetch only when no curl binary exists. Linux curl (OpenSSL) from Vercel is untested. After a burst of blocked fetches the WAF also briefly refused curl, so the module never tries fetch first. Feed quirks handled: every pubDate is stamped -0500 but the clock time is Eastern local (EDT in summer), so the wall clock is re-parsed as Eastern; descriptions often start with a stray '?' from a zero-width char; the guid changes on every edit, so sourceId is the AID. Procurement notices (RFQ/RFP/Request for Qualifications) are filtered by title (3 of 30 at test time). The feed has no categories and the RSS gives only a one-sentence summary; fetchFullText reads .article-content from /m/newsflash/home/detail/<AID> (where CivicAlerts.aspx?AID= redirects), which also shows a category badge that fetchFullText cannot return. Library programs and PSAs remain in the feed. OWNER CHECK: the owner rule is never to circumvent bot walls. This source only works because curl gets past a Cloudflare WAF block that refuses Node, the same class of workaround as MountainX's fetchAsChrome. If that counts as circumvention, disable it and ask Buncombe County Communications for an allowlist or a feed. Nothing else here depends on it (BUNCOMBE_COMMISSION_AGENDA uses the separate CivicClerk API).

name: Buncombe County Commission Agendas

access.robots: api host has no robots.txt; portal robots.txt allows all

qualityWhy: Structured JSON agenda tree (sections + numbered items) for regular meetings and the morning briefings, e.g. 'Approval of the Deaverview Master Planning Contract', 'Low-Income Housing Tax Credit & CDBG-DR Awards'.
recommendationWhy: Clean API, no Cloudflare (unlike buncombenc.gov itself), and the county's votes are core local news.
testResult: OK - 2 articles (Sep 15 briefing + regular meeting agendas); summary/contentText/categories 100%; 16-18s per run
notes: Agendas are published the Wednesday before a meeting, so at test time (Sep 24) only the Sep 15 meetings had one; Oct 6 will appear ~Sep 30. Meetings with no published Agenda file are skipped. publishedFiles[].publishOn is Eastern wall clock despite its 'Z' suffix ('Agenda Posted on September 16, 2026 9:38 AM' == '2026-09-16T09:38:23Z'). It reflects the latest (re)publish, which for Sep 15 was the day after the meeting. Item text is titles only; the staff memos are PDF/DOC attachments (attachmentsList). Minutes approvals are dropped. Only the Board of Commissioners uses this CivicClerk tenant.  The Meetings payload (~140KB) has taken 3-20s to arrive, so requests use a 45s timeout (one full run failed on the default 15s).

name: UNC Asheville
qualityWhy: Real university news (federal and NIH grants, trustee appointments, vice chancellor hires, Millennial Campus development, 50-year Botanical Garden lease) mixed with rankings and marketing awards.
recommendationWhy: Cheap, clean, full text; the only UNCA channel with press releases.
testResult: OK - 20 articles 2026-06-11..2026-09-21; contentText/image 100%, summary 95%, avg body 2794 chars
notes: unca.edu /wp/v2/posts holds only 'Hello world!'; releases live in the `article` post type (link path /in-the-news/). The `wprss_feed_item` type is the Bulldog Alert campus emergency feed (criticalarc.net), mostly tests - not ingested. stories.unca.edu (/feed.rss, ~1/2 weeks) is alumni features only - skipped. Bodies open with a hero block that repeats the title and breadcrumbs and close with an 'About UNC Asheville' boilerplate; both are cut. The embedded author is always 'UNC Asheville' so it is not used. Athletics (uncabulldogs.com) not evaluated.

name: Mission Health

access.robots: User-agent * disallows only /sitecore/ (many named scrapers fully disallowed)

qualityWhy: HCA's own releases: occasionally major ($32M capital investment across WNC hospitals, nursing-education funding), but as often awards, rankings and hiring drives.
recommendationWhy: Mission Hospital in Asheville is the region's largest hospital; the newsroom covers six WNC hospitals, so scrape() keeps only releases that name no place or name Asheville/Buncombe.
testResult: OK - 6 of 10 listed releases kept (dropped as outside Buncombe: McDowell, Blue Ridge Regional, CarePartners Macon, WCU/Angel/Highlands nursing); fetchFullText ok on 3/3 (4167-5307 chars)
notes: Sitecore + Next.js. The newsroom page embeds its first 10 results (of 49) in __NEXT_DATA__ under the NewsListingSection component's defaultResponse; article pages carry the body as route.fields.pageBody plus newsType ('Press Release') and person/location fields. publishedOn is date-only (06:00Z). The search hit newsroom.mission-health.org does not resolve. Buncombe filter: drop when title or dek matches McDowell|Marion|Angel Medical|Franklin|Macon|Highlands|Cashiers|Transylvania|Brevard|Blue Ridge Regional|Spruce Pine|Mitchell County|Yancey|Haywood|Waynesville|Hendersonville|Henderson County|Jackson County|Sylva|Rutherford unless it also says Asheville or Buncombe. A kept release can still carry a non-Buncombe dateline in the body; the AI geography pass should catch those.

name: Asheville Regional Airport

access.robots: Drupal default; /article/ and the news page allowed

qualityWhy: Parking and ride-app changes, terminal construction (AVL Forward), new baggage claim and rental counters, route announcements; about half are seasonal travel-tip posts.
recommendationWhy: Low volume, but airport service changes are widely followed and the scraper is one small HTML page.
testResult: OK - 10 articles 2026-04-16..2026-09-24; no teaser text on the list page; fetchFullText ok on 3/3 (2259-5632 chars)
notes: /rss.xml is 404. The list page gives title + <time datetime> only; body via fetchFullText from .node--type-article .field--name-field-article-body. Travel-tip posts ('Fall is Here! Check Out Some Helpful Travel Tips') are noise. /news-statistics-0/news-archives not read. Located in Fletcher (Henderson County).

name: Asheville Police Department
qualityWhy: Police-tagged city posts are mostly shared city releases (chief appointment, council recaps, preparedness month); no incident or arrest releases on the web.
recommendationWhy: Already covered by CITY_OF_ASHEVILLE; APD's breaking releases go to social media, not the website.
notes: 10 most recent Police-tagged posts span 2026-05-12..2026-09-24. Social channels are out of scope for this scout.

name: Buncombe County Sheriff's Office
qualityWhy: The WordPress site has one post ('Meet the Sheriff', 2024) and no news section; releases go to Facebook/X, and the Police-to-Citizen portal (buncombecountyso.policetocitizen.com) carries a daily bulletin rather than news.
recommendationWhy: Nothing to scrape on the web; buncombecountysheriff.org does not resolve.
notes: If the owner wants BCSO, it has to come from social (another scout's category) or the P2C bulletin (not evaluated).

name: Asheville City Schools

access.robots: Crawl-delay 5; disallows /fs/ (where Finalsite's RSS and element endpoints live)

qualityWhy: About 5 district-news posts in 7 months (Best in AVL, teacher of the year, literacy), several duplicated.
recommendationWhy: Too little volume and mostly recognition posts; the feed endpoints are robots-disallowed.
notes: Board of Education agendas (probably BoardDocs) would be the newsworthy ACS channel; not evaluated. robots.txt is no longer a blocker (owner, 2026-09-25): the /news-and-announcements3 page parses from a.fsPostLink + time[datetime], but at ~5 posts in 7 months it is not worth a module yet.

name: Buncombe County Schools

access.robots: thrillshare-cmsv2.services.thrillshare.com has no robots.txt (404); buncombeschools.org disallows only its own /api/

qualityWhy: Daily school feature stories (field days, arts week, flag football) plus a weekly 'Week in Review'; occasional hard news such as 'Dr. Jennifer Reed Named Superintendent' (2026-09-24).
recommendationWhy: In scope under Asheville + Buncombe. The Thrillshare JSON API makes it one ~200KB request with full bodies, so the ~85% school features are cheap to carry and the AI pass can surface the district news (superintendent appointment 2026-09-24).
testResult: OK - 20 articles 2026-09-05..2026-09-24; summary/contentText/image/author 100%, categories 35%, avg body 1477 chars
notes: The site renders from Thrillshare CMS v2: /api/v2/s/191491/articles returns 20 articles a page (79 pages) with full HTML content, snippet, cover_image, author, published_at (with offset) and filter_name tags. Section id 191491 is the district News section, found in the news page HTML; sibling sections expose live_feeds (191490: closure alerts), events and documents. The 1.7MB server-rendered /o/bcs/news page is the fallback. 'Week in Review' posts are a video embed with a one-line caption.

name: A-B Tech Community College
qualityWhy: Mostly alumni profiles ('Made in Asheville', nursing alumna), with the odd big item ('A-B Tech Awarded $29.2 Million Federal Grant for WNC Futures Factory').
recommendationWhy: Only reachable through fetchAsChrome past a Cloudflare managed challenge, which the owner's no-bot-wall rule excludes, and even that failed on 2 of 4 runs on 2026-09-25. Low signal (alumni profiles) besides.
notes: rss.xml has 10 items with the full body in <description> (.field--name-body). A module was written and then removed: fetchAsChrome was challenged 4/4 times on two of four runs, with the feed Accept header and a browser Accept alike. Plain fetch with NEWS_USER_AGENT still gets 'Just a moment...'. Revisit if A-B Tech exposes a feed outside Cloudflare.

name: NCDOT (Division 13 / WNC filter)

access.robots: RSS.aspx allowed; the real feed endpoint (/news/_layouts/15/feed.aspx) is under a disallowed */_layouts/ path

qualityWhy: Statewide releases, ~7/day, mostly road closures in other counties; WNC items (I-40/I-26 closures, Helene road rebuilds) are high-value when they appear.
recommendationWhy: Statewide; under the owner's scope it should only be built with a Buncombe / Division 13 filter, and at test time the 15 listed releases (2 days) had zero matches, so it would usually emit nothing. Revisit once the pipeline tolerates empty runs or a Division 13 listing is found.
notes: The press-releases page itself is JS-rendered. RSS.aspx server-renders the latest 15 releases as li.dfwp-item > a[href] + div.description; URL paths carry a date (Pages/2026/2026-09-24-slug.aspx) that is sometimes the event date, not the publish date. Filter on county names (Buncombe, Haywood, Henderson, Madison, McDowell, Yancey, Mitchell, Transylvania, Rutherford, Polk) plus I-40/I-26/Asheville/Division 13. For live closures, DriveNC incident data would be a separate, non-news integration.

name: Asheville Water Resources
qualityWhy: Water news appears as city posts (new director, neighborhood infrastructure improvements).
recommendationWhy: Covered by CITY_OF_ASHEVILLE.
notes: Outage and boil-water alerts are pushed through AVL Alert / the Asheville app, not the website; not evaluated.

name: Metropolitan Sewerage District of Buncombe County
qualityWhy: Static PHP site with public-notice and street-interruption pages; no news or press section.
recommendationWhy: Nothing article-shaped to ingest.
notes: publicnotices.php / streetinterruptions.php could feed a future service-alerts surface, not the news feed.

name: Explore Asheville / Buncombe County Tourism Development Authority
qualityWhy: Useful when active (TPDF grants, festival funding, BCTDA meeting highlights), but both channels are stale.
recommendationWhy: ashevillecvb.com posts stop at 2025-05-29; the exploreasheville.com partner-news page (behind Cloudflare) lists the same 2024-25 articles. BCTDA budget and grant votes reach the feed through newsroom coverage.
notes: Re-check in a few months; the existing events scraper already handles exploreasheville.com's Cloudflare via curl. Plain fetch with NEWS_USER_AGENT is still challenged by Cloudflare (2026-09-25).

name: Asheville Area Chamber of Commerce
qualityWhy: Member spotlights ('For This Local Real Estate Team...') and the biweekly 'Business Buzz' newsletter; promotional.
recommendationWhy: Almost no news value.
notes: Business Buzz occasionally mentions openings; not worth the noise.

name: Dogwood Health Trust
qualityWhy: Own releases are significant (HCA independent monitor reports, $10.5M primary-care collaborative, emergency funding) but rare, and the posts endpoint mixes in reposted press coverage from other outlets.
recommendationWhy: Region-wide (18 WNC counties) with about one real release a month, and the posts endpoint mixes in reposted coverage from other outlets. Under the Asheville + Buncombe scope it would need a Buncombe filter plus a way to drop reposts.
notes: Latest post 2026-08-04 at test time. Titles like 'Private partners donate money ... - WCCB Charlotte' are reposted coverage.

name: Town of Weaverville

access.robots: Allow except wp-admin, search and cart

qualityWhy: Public hearing notices (zoning map/text amendments), watershed meetings, fire apparatus; mostly severe-weather briefings and meeting cancellations.
recommendationWhy: In scope under Asheville + Buncombe; a trivial WP REST source whose categories (Public Hearing, Helene Recovery, Town Council) let the pipeline keep zoning hearings and recovery projects and drop weather briefings.
testResult: OK - 20 articles 2026-06-24..2026-09-23; summary/contentText 80% (weather briefings have empty bodies), categories 100%
notes: Some category names bundle several labels with '|' ('Town Boards & Committees|Town Events|Town News'); the module splits them and drops News / Town News / Uncategorized. Severe-weather briefings are an embedded image or PDF with no text. No featured images.

name: Town of Black Mountain

access.robots: not checked (owner: robots.txt is not a blocker)

qualityWhy: Council meeting recaps, press releases (grants, staffing, Helene recovery, public safety), the monthly newsletter, water and sanitation notices.
recommendationWhy: Largest Buncombe town after Asheville, and its posts are real town news (council recaps, interim town manager, $1.9M flood-mitigation grant, police press releases).
testResult: OK - 25 articles 2026-02-01..2026-09-24; summary 100%, image 96%; fetchFullText ok on 3/3 (248-9948 chars)
notes: The town's RSS feeds are nearly empty (All: 2 items, News Flash category: 1, Police: 0) although the site lists ~40 posts going back about a year, so the module reads the /m/newsflash?cat=1 list (~540KB, one request) and caps at 25. List dates are day-only ('Posted on September 24, 2026'), so publishedAt is midnight Eastern. Some entries link straight to a Document Center PDF (police press releases, some newsletters): those keep the PDF URL and use the list preview, which often holds the whole release, as contentText. Newsletter posts have an empty body with their text in the header description; the shared CivicPlus helper falls back to it. Shares lib/news/sources/shared/civicplus.ts with BUNCOMBE_COUNTY; plain fetch works here.

name: Town of Woodfin
qualityWhy: One news post in 2026 (Aug 7); the list is mostly 2022 public-hearing notices.
recommendationWhy: Effectively inactive.
notes: Quarterly newsletters are the town's real channel.

name: Town of Biltmore Forest
qualityWhy: Town notices: property tax bills delayed, town hall schedule, Labor Day closure, election info, speaker series.
recommendationWhy: In scope under Asheville + Buncombe and nearly free (one small HTML page); the signal is low, so this is for completeness rather than value.
testResult: OK - 6 articles 2026-08-05..2026-09-22; summary 100%; fetchFullText ok on 3/3 (298-656 chars)
notes: List rows are a.news-item with <time datetime> and a teaser that is often the full notice; the body comes from article.node--type-news .field--name-body. The list shows ~6 posts, enough for a 6-hourly cron.

name: Town of Montreat
qualityWhy: Weekly 'Montreat Minute' newsletter (council previews, ordinance enforcement, road and water work), a 'Mayor's Summary' after each council meeting, and many 'Notice' posts (board meetings, hydrant flushing, road closures).
recommendationWhy: In scope under Asheville + Buncombe. Reachable now that news fetches send NEWS_USER_AGENT; categories separate the Mayor's Summary recaps and the weekly newsletter from routine notices.
testResult: OK - 20 articles 2026-07-30..2026-09-18; summary/contentText/image 100%, categories 95%, avg body 2873 chars
notes: The earlier 403 was Automattic's CDN (a8c-cdn) rejecting the stale Chrome/120 UA, not a bot wall; fetchWpPosts with NEWS_USER_AGENT gets 200. 1,387 posts in total. Bylines are staff first names, so author is left empty. Population under 1,000; expect the AI pass to drop most Notices.

name: Buncombe County Election Services
qualityWhy: Election guides, early voting, poll worker recruitment, certifications.
recommendationWhy: Already included in BUNCOMBE_COUNTY's all-categories feed; a separate module would only duplicate it.
notes: Around the Nov 3 midterm this category will spike; no separate feed or site exists.
